import java.util.*;
import java.lang.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Ideone {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.lang.Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String a = sc.next();

        boolean inside = false;
        int best = 0;
        int words = 0;
        int len = 0;
        int i = 0;

        while (i < n) {
            char c = a.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '_':
                    if (inside && len != 0) {
                        words++;
                    } else {
                        if (len > best) best = len;
                    }
                    len = 0;
                    break;
                case '(':
                    inside = true;
                    if (len > best) best = len;
                    len = 0;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    inside = false;
                    if (len > 0) {
                        words++;
                    }
                    len = 0;
                    break;
                default:
                    len++;
            }
            i++;
        }

        if (len > best) best = len;
        System.out.println(best + " " + words);
    }
}

public class Ideone {

    static void consume(char c, boolean[] inParen, int[] data) {
        // data[0] = max outside word length
        // data[1] = number of words inside parentheses
        // data[2] = current word length
        if (c == '_') {
            if (inParen[0] && data[2] != 0) {
                data[1]++;
            } else if (data[2] > data[0]) {
                data[0] = data[2];
            }
            data[2] = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            inParen[0] = true;
            if (data[2] > data[0]) {
                data[0] = data[2];
            }
            data[2] = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inParen[0] = false;
            if (data[2] > 0) {
                data[1]++;
            }
            data[2] = 0;
        } else {
            data[2]++;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.lang.Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String a = sc.next();

        boolean[] inside = new boolean[] { false };
        int[] d = new int[] { 0, 0, 0 };

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            consume(a.charAt(i), inside, d);
        }

        if (d[2] > d[0]) {
            d[0] = d[2];
        }

        System.out.println(d[0] + " " + d[1]);
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.lang.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Ideone {

    static class WordCounter {
        boolean paren = false;
        int max = 0;
        int count = 0;
        int temp = 0;

        void process(char c) {
            if (c == '_') {
                if (paren && temp != 0) {
                    count++;
                } else if (temp > max) {
                    max = temp;
                }
                temp = 0;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                paren = true;
                if (temp > max) {
                    max = temp;
                }
                temp = 0;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                paren = false;
                if (temp > 0) {
                    count++;
                }
                temp = 0;
            } else {
                temp++;
            }
        }

        void finish() {
            if (temp > max) {
                max = temp;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.lang.Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String a = sc.next();

        WordCounter wc = new WordCounter();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            wc.process(a.charAt(i));
        }
        wc.finish();

        System.out.println(wc.max + " " + wc.count);
    }
}
